newsitem.title: UK: Downing Street says UK budget leak genuine.
newsitem.headline: Downing Street says UK budget leak genuine.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major's Downing Street office confirmed on Tuesday that budget papers leaked to the Daily Mirror on the eve of Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke's budget statement were genuine.
A spokeswoman said the papers handed in to Downing Street by the Daily Mirror on Monday were genuine, but said she could make no further comment.
Asked about the Sun newspaper's report which included what it said were budget details, the spokeswoman said the Treasury spoke for the government.
The report said Clarke would cut one penny off income tax.
A Treasury spokesman declined comment on the Mirror papers on Tuesday, but dismissed the Sun story as "pure speculation".
